Floorline Snare.name: Floorline Snare
Floorline Snare.description: The user fixes tape between two low anchors across a passage. The first running target who crosses it trips and remains tangled until the end of their next turn, giving an ally time to apply cuffs. A cautious target can see and step over the line, and a blade or hard pull can break it. Strain: moderate.
